$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the matrix renders its Detailed Mapping as a table with no section
per criterion, so no heading names a criterion and readMatrix reads no section at all. Every
status in the table is right, and none of it is scoreable, because the per-criterion statuses are the
one measurement the summary does not carry and the section shape is the contract for reading them.
This case pins that outcome as an environment failure, the class runCase reports when the matrix is
missing or declares no section, with nothing scored. The
summary beside it is clean-correct-run's and passes readSummary, so it is the matrix alone that stops
derivation: readSummary accepts the summary at 0.3.0. readMatrix then scans the matrix for headings of the shape
`#### AC-n:` and finds none, because the mapping is a table whose rows are not headings, so byCriterion
stays empty and it returns null. runCase reports a null matrix as environment-missing-artifact, and
